top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a falsifiable mechanism tested quantitatively: spin-orbit coupling plus time-reversal symmetry gives a Z2 invariant with protected edge channels (Kane and Mele), and Molenkamp's HgTe wells showed conductance near 2e^2/h that disappears in wide samples. About eighteen years of transport and photoemission work in many materials has confirmed it, so maturity is not in doubt. The allocation is imperfect because Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang and Hasan are left out, but the citation can be kept to the quantum spin Hall state and its first observation, and that is better than no award.
